biography: Tomas, representing Espoo Ringside Golf, has been a familiar figure across three editions of the Hector Trophée. His involvement in this premier pairs competition has consistently demonstrated a profound respect for the game and its traditions.

Across these three appearances, Tomas approached the challenge with an unwavering focus. Though a victory in the Hector Trophée alongside a partner, or indeed the individual Victor Trophy, remained just beyond his grasp, his tenacious play and composed demeanor were readily apparent to observers. His commitment underscored a sportsmanlike drive, even in the absence of a championship title.

As the Hector Trophée 2026 approaches, Tomas will not be joining the field, having stepped away from regular participation in Hector events. His chapter in the tournament's history, while not featuring a trophy, is characterized by a commendable perseverance and a genuine passion for the sport, leaving an indelible mark on those who witnessed his play.
